PROGRAM HOLDSROD1
      IMPLICIT NONE
C     /SDR2X5/ as srod1.f declares it
      REAL ECPT(17), DUMMY1(83)
      INTEGER IELID, ISILNO(2)
      REAL SAT(3), SBT(3), SAR(3), SBR(3)
      REAL ST, SDELTA, AREA, FJOVRC
      REAL TSUBC0, SIGMAT, SIGMAC, SIGMAS
      REAL SIGVEC(77), FORVEC(25)
      COMMON /SDR2X5/ ECPT, DUMMY1, IELID, ISILNO,
     1  SAT, SBT, SAR, SBR, ST, SDELTA, AREA, FJOVRC,
     2  TSUBC0, SIGMAT, SIGMAC, SIGMAS, SIGVEC, FORVEC
      REAL XN(6), TI(9)
      REAL XL, EOVERL
      INTEGER IBASE
      COMMON /SDR2X6/ XN, TI, XL, EOVERL, IBASE
      INTEGER IECPT(17)
      EQUIVALENCE (IECPT(1), ECPT(1))
      REAL AXS, AXF, TORS
      INTEGER I
      DO 10 I = 1, 17
        ECPT(I) = 0.0
   10 CONTINUE
      IECPT(1)=100
      IECPT(2)=1
      IECPT(3)=2
      IECPT(4)=1
      ECPT(5)= 0.01
      ECPT(6)= 5e-06
      ECPT(7)= 0.001
      ECPT(8)= 0.0
      IECPT(9)=0
      ECPT(10)= 0.0
      ECPT(11)= 0.0
      ECPT(12)= 0.0
      IECPT(13)=0
      ECPT(14)= 2
      ECPT(15)= 0.0
      ECPT(16)= 0.0
      ECPT(17)= 0.0
      CALL SROD1
      AXS = SAT(1)*0+SAT(2)*0+SAT(3)*0+SBT(1)*0.001+SBT(2)*0+SBT(3)*0
      AXF = AXS * AREA
      TORS = SAR(1)*0+SAR(2)*0+SAR(3)*0+SBR(1)*0+SBR(2)*0+SBR(3)*0
      TORS = 0.0
      WRITE(6,'(A1)') 'S'
      WRITE(6,'(3(ES25.17,1X))') AXS, AXF, TORS
      STOP
      END

      TI(4)=0.0; TI(5)=1.0; TI(6)=0.0

      END
      SUBROUTINE GMMATS (A, NROWA, NCOLA, ITRANSA,
     1  B, NROWB, NCOLB, ITRANSB, C)
      INTEGER NROWA, NCOLA, ITRANSA, NROWB, NCOLB, ITRANSB
      REAL A(NROWA,NCOLA), B(NROWB,NCOLB), C(*)
      INTEGER I, J, K, IDX
      REAL SUM
      IDX = 0
      DO 100 J = 1, NCOLB
        DO 90 I = 1, NROWA
          SUM = 0.0
          DO 80 K = 1, NCOLA
            IF (ITRANSA .EQ. 0) THEN
              IF (ITRANSB .EQ. 0) SUM = SUM + A(I,K)*B(K,J)
              IF (ITRANSB .NE. 0) SUM = SUM + A(I,K)*B(J,K)
            ELSE
              IF (ITRANSB .EQ. 0) SUM = SUM + A(K,I)*B(K,J)
              IF (ITRANSB .NE. 0) SUM = SUM + A(K,I)*B(J,K)
            END IF
   80      CONTINUE
          IDX = IDX + 1
          C(IDX) = SUM
   90    CONTINUE
  100 CONTINUE
      RETURN
      END
